name: localflow
description: Local, private, CPU-first voice pipeline for macOS, Windows, and Linux

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:rust && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --test integration --test acceptance --test performance --test tray
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && npm run test:ui && npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:dictionary && npm run test:personalization
scripts.test:pipeline: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked pipeline --lib
scripts.test:dictionary: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked dictionary --lib
scripts.test:personalization: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked personalization --lib
scripts.test:ai: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --features ai-bench --test ai_bench
scripts.check:local: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --quiet -- check
scripts.download:stt: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --quiet -- download
scripts.check: npm run check:gate && npm run check:rust
scripts.check:license: npm run license:check && npm run uniqueness:check
scripts.check:rust: node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets && node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.format: prettier --write . && node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev && node scripts/run-with-toolchain.mjs cargo audit --file src-tauri/Cargo.lock
